verdict.rationale: Community reports show TeamViewer has a macOS client that can be installed to control another desktop, and that it runs on Windows PCs, so at least two desktop platforms are covered. Nothing documents mobile viewer or host apps: the Mobile SDK is a developer add-on, and mobile device management is a different feature. Nothing explicitly confirms cross-OS host/viewer sessions either. missing for 10: first-party supported-platform list, evidence of mobile (iOS/Android) clients, explicit confirmation that host and viewer can run on different operating systems, Linux coverage.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems

citations.quote: Mac complaint: TeamViewer can't be installed without admin permissions even if you only want to control another desktop.
One user runs TeamViewer on a single PC only to log into Windows and start Steam
